###Strategy

Let's use the data in the graph to find the height of this type of coral when its age is $1$ year. Since the coral grows at a constant rate, we can then write an equation to find its height ($h$) at any age ($a$).

###Unit rate and equation

[[☃ image 1]]

$a$ | $1$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div 2}$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$
:- | -: | -: | -: | -: | -:
$h$ | $7.5$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div 2}$ | $15$ | $30$ | $45$

The coral's height grows $7.5\,\text{cm}$ every $1$ year, so we can write an equation to find the height ($h$) at any age ($a$):

$h=7.5a$
